verdict.rationale: Zapier documents several public APIs: Workflow API, Actions, Connections and Trigger Inbox, each with OpenAPI specs. It also offers an SDK/CLI and MCP that execute actions and let customers build workflows programmatically. Nothing claims or shows that every UI capability has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, API coverage for Canvas, Agents, troubleshooting and team/admin settings, a stability/deprecation policy for the public APIs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use Zapier's Workflow API and 9,000 integrations to power a built-in automation experience, integration marketplace, or AI workflows.
Bring Zapier’s automation into your own product so customers can build workflows and run actions without leaving your app.
Install @zapier/zapier-sdk via npm, authenticate with OAuth or client credentials, and execute actions across 9,000+ apps.
